en.title: Full Stack Developer (MERN Stack)
en.text: Developed and maintained scalable full-stack web applications using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js) and Next.js. Focused on clean architecture, performance optimization, API integration, and Agile development practices.
list: Designed and developed scalable full-stack applications using the MERN stack and Next.js following modern engineering standards.
Built and integrated RESTful APIs and third-party services to enhance application performance and functionality.
Managed MongoDB databases with strong focus on schema design, indexing, and query optimization.
Collaborated with UI/UX designers, QA engineers, and backend developers to deliver high-quality production-ready applications.
Maintained code quality through Git version control, peer code reviews, debugging, and structured deployment workflows.
Participated actively in Agile/Scrum methodologies including sprint planning, standups, and technical discussions.
